state.source: PX4 ULog vehicle_local_position xyz/vxyz (NED) and vehicle_attitude quaternion (FRD-to-NED). Replay uORB publication timestamp truncated to MAVLink time_boot_ms, not timestamp_sample. Use production PolicyStateHistory and policy_state.
state.goal: Mission telemetry before/after the capture must agree on target and waypoint index and match the run metadata phase and waypoint. Use the run metadata waypoint speed and logged speed scale.
state.validity: No extrapolation, no position/velocity invalidity or estimator reset across a bracket. Require all six faithful reconstructed pairs and matching checkpoint/route. If unavailable, report input pairing failure and do not run inference.
state.scope: uORB estimates are the source of MAVLink values. The exact throttled MAVLink packet set was not archived. Record the ULog bracket and distinguish this reconstruction from a byte-identical historical actor request. No simulator truth, modified survey pose or actor reply is read for state.

treatment.control: Original archived metric depth PNG reconstructed with the same encoding handling as the stereo experiment.
treatment.perturbed: Same image processed with the frozen stereo probe finite_far_edge_mismatch transform. Verify changed pixel count and preprocessed policy metrics against prior experiment. The state bytes are shared within the pair.

metrics.velocity_flu_m_s: Signed forward, left and up components of each actor output before controller or boundary guard.
metrics.forward_closing_m_s: Signed forward body-axis component toward the forward camera view. Also report the projection toward the current waypoint separately.
metrics.norm_m_s: Euclidean speed norm and paired difference.
metrics.vector_delta_norm_m_s: Euclidean norm of perturbed minus control velocity, distinct from change in speed magnitude.

scope_limits: Paired open-loop network output sensitivity for selected archived views under synthetic finite depth substitutions. This experiment does not assess obstacle trajectories, estimator response, closed-loop safety or real OAK depth.
